_source: Existing hits of tools/checks/commerce-terms.txt, recorded when the gate was introduced (issue #905). Every entry is copy that already shipped; the ratchet only refuses new ones. Remove an entry when its string is rewritten or deleted: the gate reports a stale entry as a failure until then.

plugins/linker-commerce/includes/Abiliti.string: Two product IDs: one inverter and one battery, in either order.
plugins/linker-commerce/includes/Abiliti.justification: either argument order of a compatibility check

plugins/linker-commerce/includes/Stock/S.string: One row per pushed item, in request order.
plugins/linker-commerce/includes/Stock/S.justification: the order rows arrive in a request

apps/planner/src/components/ProfileLabel.string: Intervals must be in time order and must not overlap. Correct the source rather than sorting it here.
apps/planner/src/components/ProfileLabel.justification: time order of CSV intervals, not a purchase

apps/planner/src/components/energy/Energ.string: The PV reference needs a retained weather source, two ordered sampling grids and complete PV model parameters.
apps/planner/src/components/energy/Energ.justification: ordered sampling grids in a PV input, not a purchase

apps/planner/src/components/energy/Plann.string: The PV string CSV has one row per string and time interval. The module condition lists follow the order of module IDs in that row.
apps/planner/src/components/energy/Plann.justification: order of module IDs inside a CSV row
